tx_count_daily

See methodology: /methodology#tx_count_daily
#tx_count_daily
Basic

Counts how many transactions were recorded that day. It is a direct, price-agnostic proxy for day-to-day network usage.

Advanced

Daily transaction count for the chain (unit: transactions/day). Gold field: tx_count_daily from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. The UI contextualizes the raw series with MA7/MA30 (from derived where available, otherwise computed as a trailing average over available days).

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

unique_active_addresses

See methodology: /methodology#unique_active_addresses
#unique_active_addresses
Basic

Counts how many unique addresses were active that day (sent or received a transaction). It approximates participation breadth rather than raw throughput.

Advanced

Unique active addresses per day (unit: addresses/day), as defined by the pipeline’s address-activity logic. Gold field: unique_active_addresses from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Exact activity definition can vary by chain data model (e.g., UTXO vs account-based); see methodology caveats.

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

median_tx_fee_native

See methodology: /methodology#median_tx_fee_native
#median_tx_fee_native
Basic

The median fee paid per transaction that day, denominated in the chain’s native token. It describes fee pressure and competition for limited capacity without using price.

Advanced

Median per-transaction fee in native units (median across transactions observed on the date). Gold field: median_tx_fee_native from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Fee definition follows chain conventions (e.g., gas_used * effective_gas_price for EVM chains, fee components for BTC).

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

gas_utilization_pct

See methodology: /methodology#gas_utilization_pct
#gas_utilization_pct
Basic

How full blocks were on average that day, expressed as a percent of capacity. It is a descriptive capacity-pressure signal.

Advanced

Daily average of gas_used / gas_limit (or equivalent capacity metric), expressed as percent. Gold field: gas_utilization_pct from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. For non-EVM chains this metric may be structurally not applicable and is expected to be null.

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

failed_tx_rate

See methodology: /methodology#failed_tx_rate
#failed_tx_rate
Basic

The share of transactions that failed that day (as a percent). It describes execution friction and potential UX degradation without implying blame.

Advanced

Daily failure ratio (failed / total) expressed as percent, based on chain-specific failure semantics. Gold field: failed_tx_rate from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. For chains where failure semantics are not available or not meaningful, the metric may be null.

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

avg_block_time_sec

See methodology: /methodology#avg_block_time_sec
#avg_block_time_sec
Basic

Average time between blocks that day (in seconds). It is an operational stability indicator.

Advanced

Daily average block interval (seconds) based on observed block timestamps. Gold field: avg_block_time_sec from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Interpretation differs by chain (e.g., PoW variance vs fixed-slot systems).

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

block_count_daily

See methodology: /methodology#block_count_daily
#block_count_daily
Basic

Counts how many blocks were produced that day. It describes production output and operational regularity.

Advanced

Daily block count (unit: blocks/day) from observed on-chain block production. Gold field: block_count_daily from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Closely related to avg_block_time_sec but more robust to outliers in time deltas.

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

value_transferred_native

See methodology: /methodology#value_transferred_native
#value_transferred_native
Basic

Total amount of the native token transferred on-chain that day. It provides an economic-throughput proxy without using any price data.

Advanced

Daily sum of native token value transferred (native units/day), as computed by the pipeline. Gold field: value_transferred_native from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Transfer accounting is chain-specific (e.g., UTXO outputs vs account transfers); see caveats.

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

median_tx_value_native

See methodology: /methodology#median_tx_value_native
#median_tx_value_native
Basic

Median value transferred per transaction that day, denominated in the chain’s native token. It adds context to activity and total value transferred.

Advanced

Median per-transaction transferred value in native units (median across transactions observed on the date). Gold field: median_tx_value_native from public/data/published/v1/gold/<chain>/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Exact definition depends on how transfers are extracted per chain (UTXO vs account-based).

See also: Coverage · Freshness · Moving averages · Methodology page

Concepts

Moving averages (MA7 / MA30)

#moving-averages
Basic

A moving average smooths daily noise by averaging recent days. MA7 is short-term smoothing; MA30 is longer-term context.

Advanced

MA7 and MA30 are returned by the API as separate series fields. They are sourced from derived outputs when available; otherwise computed as trailing averages over available (present) days. Missing days are not interpolated.

Coverage

#coverage
Basic

Coverage tells you whether the selected window has complete data. Missing days are not treated as zero.

Advanced

Every series response includes expected_days, present_days, missing_days, and a nonNull_ratio. These fields are computed from the gold manifest and the actual values in the daily files.

Freshness / lag

#freshness
Basic

Freshness tells you how up-to-date the dataset is (as-of date and lag).

Advanced

Freshness is derived from gold/<chain>/manifest.json (asof) and compared to today (UTC) to compute lag_days. Chains may legitimately have different lags depending on upstream indexing.
